data.one_liner: A package to use alert, toast, popup, snack, and loading anywhere with customizable styles.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive collection of overlay-based UI components like alerts, confirms, prompts, toasts, modals, popups, image previews, snacks, loadings, and dropdowns. Can be called anywhere in the app using a navigator key without needing a BuildContext.
use_when: You need a quick way to show toasts, alerts, and confirmation dialogs from anywhere in your code.
You want customizable overlay widgets with support for custom themes.
avoid_when: You prefer strictly declarative state-driven dialog routing inside your widget tree.
You only need native platform dialogs.
strengths: Allows calling dialogs and toasts anywhere without passing a BuildContext.
Supports a wide variety of dialog types including alerts, toasts, loading indicators, and dropdowns.
weaknesses: Requires setting up a navigator key in your MaterialApp or router.
Older flutter versions require specific handling of theme extensions.
data.setup_notes: Add localizations and configure the navigatorKey in your MaterialApp or router, and register the ShirneDialogTheme.
